patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections with dynamic imagery and fixed overlay elements, transitioning to a grid-based content layout for subsequent sections.
Strategic use of a vibrant brand orange as an accent color for CTAs and key highlights against a predominantly dark grey and white background.
Strong, all-caps sans-serif typography for headings and navigation, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, reinforcing a modern and authoritative brand voice.
The hero section features a dynamic background that transitions through a sequence of full-bleed images or video clips as the user scrolls, while interactive buttons remain fixed in place.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth and engaging scroll experience.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-bleed video or image sequence that changes dynamically based on scroll depth or a timed interval, with interactive overlay elements positioned absolutely to remain fixed over the changing background.
Content sections are animated into view using a scroll-triggered library like GSAP, applying a subtle fade-in and vertical translation effect as each section's trigger point enters the viewport.
The main navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, maintaining its position at the top of the screen throughout the user's scroll, ensuring persistent access to site navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Bold, uppercase headings are significantly larger (~3-4x body text) with a clean sans-serif character, while body text is compact and highly legible.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and image cards, maintaining a sleek and modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, particularly in hero and between major content blocks, with tighter grids for news and feature cards.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic and immersive full-bleed hero, which uses a sequence of high-impact brand imagery that transitions on scroll, immediately conveying a sense of luxury, performance, and brand identity. This creates a powerful and memorable first impression that goes beyond a static hero.
